subject: rt-op
title: RT.OP.------POL.DY.
description: Diagram in NYM-12, on the page where Braxton argues that 'by separating the music from the black community, the net effect of this control would find black musicians having to rely on the whims of the western defining and controlling community for survival.' RT-OP (reality options) is crossed with POL-DYM (political dynamics). POL-DYM → RT-OP and POL-DYM → TRS (transition); ALT-F (alternative functionalism) → RT-OP. TRS receives multiple feeds: SPT-GH (spiritual growth), VT-ATT (vibrational attitude), UNF-PI (unification positively intended), TR-DEF (trans-definition), PART (participation). SPT-GH → POST (postulation) → SF-RZ (self-realization). Structural argument: reality options, when crossed with political dynamics, run through political dynamics directly (no intermediate) — meaning the political-dynamics regime *immediately* constrains options. Transition is the alternative-route hub, fed by *five* parallel upstreams (spiritual growth, vibrational attitude, unification-positively-intended, trans-definition, participation), and producing self-realization through the postulation chain (via spiritual growth). The diagram thus stages the post-Ayler structural choice: reality options are gated by political dynamics directly, but transition offers an alternative path saturated with spiritual/vibrational inputs (5 feeds) — the only route that produces self-realization. The political-dynamics → reality-options direct edge captures Braxton's diagnostic claim about 'special treatment' the post-Ayler musicians faced.
